editorial.blurb: Ema is a beautiful Mediterranean destination where fresh, thoughtfully prepared small plates shine in an elegant space designed for sharing with friends.
editorial.insiderTip: Order 6+ dishes to share with your group—the small plates format is the way to experience Ema, and ask your server about accommodations for dietary needs, which the kitchen handles beautifully.

topDishes.note: Tender meat with exceptional veggies and rice
